comment: Independent selvar.c selection_do_randline() witness through dat/Bar-strt.lua's selection.randline(selection.new(), 37,7, 62,02, 7). nhlsel.c l_selection_randline() passes both endpoints through get_location_coord(), so the midpoints are map coordinates (this map's ystart is 1). This seed draws a midpoint on map row 0, which C accepts; a Lua-relative midpoint would be row -1 and repeat the retry loop. Seed chosen by recording seeds 4410021-4410090 and keeping the one whose path reaches row 0. #wizloaddes loads the level; #wizmap shows it.
